Action.title: Action
Action.description: Represents an animation action verb and its sequential frames

id.description: The unique ID for the action, e.g. L-01

verb_name.description: Dynamic verb label of the action

thumbnail_path.description: Relative path or Base64 Data URL for thumbnail preview

frames.description: Array of paths or Base64 Data URLs representing each frame animation sequence

Weapon.title: Weapon
Weapon.description: Represents an item or weapon from the survival-horror store library

id.description: The unique ID for the weapon, e.g. W-01

description.description: Aesthetic and tactical description of the gear

thumbnail_path.description: Relative path or Base64 Data URL for thumbnail preview

image_path.description: The primary default image representation path

images.description: List of user-uploaded composite reference images in Base64 or local paths

GeneratedAsset.title: GeneratedAsset
GeneratedAsset.description: Represents an AI synthesis target output mapping and telemetry log

output_image_path.description: Base64 or server static upload destination path

Character.title: Character
Character.description: Represents a validated 2D character avatar template saved for alignment and multi-view generation

imageUrl.description: The base64 encoded character illustration or local path

category.description: Anatomical category e.g. Human Biped, Quadruped

isHuman.description: Specifies if character has human features

isComplete.description: Specifies if body is fully showing and complete

isQuadruped.description: Specifies if character is a four-legged quadruped

isExtraterrestrial.description: Specifies if character is an extraterrestrial alien creature

hairColor.description: Primary hair hexadecimal or name color

suitColor.description: Primary costume hexadecimal or name color

SpriteCacheItem.title: SpriteCacheItem
SpriteCacheItem.description: Represents an auto-separated sprite cutout stored in the pose cache

url.description: Base64 or server static upload destination path of the cutout

originalUrl.description: Original image URL from which this cutout was extracted

prompt.description: AI prompt or label for the cutout

actions.description: The persistent library repository of cartoon animation action verbs

weapons.description: The storage directory of survival gear and weapon blueprints

assets.description: Historical repository of generated pose assets

characters.description: Registry of validated avatars stored for design alignment overlays

sprite_cache.description: Persistent repository of auto-separated cutout sprites for next-session recovery
